title: Add the signals command
goal: Expose the eight signals through the CLI as key: value lines, so an operator can read a finished run without opening JSON. The output format is pinned by the brief's worked example because brief 0002 acceptance item 6 compares it against what the driver prints.
acceptance: runstat signals <run-dir> prints exactly the eight key: value lines in the brief's order
The command exits 0 on a readable run
The implementation stays within what the brief asks for
